QuestInfo.name: [Stone Colossus] My Pal Chino
QuestInfo.0: Continue your conversation with #bKupo#k at #bKupo's Station#k.
QuestInfo.1: Collect #b50 Hornet Honey#k from the #rHornets#k and #b50 Large Poison Glands#k from the #rPoison Hornets#k for #bChino#k at Chino's Station.
QuestInfo.2: You collected 50 Hornet Honey items from the Hornets, and 50 Large Poison Glands from the Poison Hornets, for Chino at Chino's Station.

0.0: You're not gonna give up? We must be friends for life. I HAVE DECREED IT.
0.1: Even if we're friends, we can't continue up on the ride. If there's another earthquake, we'll roll down. Well, don't worry. It's not like we don't have a way.
0.2: Keep heading east and talk to my friend #bChino#k. She's more than capable of getting you up to that colossus.

yes.0: Oh, but you'd better bring her something as thanks. #bChino#k would be stoked if you brought her #r50 Hornet Honey and Large Poison Glands#k. She hates hornets so much.

1.0: Ah, another hornet-hater! Welcome to the club.

yes.0: I saw you out there, cracking those stupid exoskeletons open. I watched from my perch. Because I'm a sniper.

npc.0: Collect 50 Hornet Honey from Hornets, and 50 Large Poison Glands from Poison Hornets, for Chino. Just keep heading East to see her.

item.0: Yes?\r\n#b(Collect 50 Hornet Honey from Hornets and 50 Large Poison Glands from Poison Hornets.)#k\r\n
